name: The Star of Bethnal Green
summary: A Bethnal Green pub run by the Electric Star group, which reopened it after a 2008 refurbishment. It is known for its private karaoke rooms, alongside DJ nights and guest street-food kitchens.

music.notes: DJ sets and disco nights, karaoke (CAMRA lists DJs and karaoke Thursday to Sunday, and there are five private rooms), drag brunches and a pub quiz.

accessibility.notes: CAMRA says there is a small step at the entrance and an accessible toilet.

story.opened: Dates back to 1810, according to Time Out, when it was The White Hart.
story.then: Time Out says a 2008 refurbishment relaunched it as the lead pub of the Electric Star Group.
story.now: The venue's own website says its kitchen has long hosted street-food traders, and Peck Peck Chicken is now the guest kitchen. Themed private karaoke rooms can be booked; the Studio 54 room takes groups of up to 18.
story.vibe: Time Out calls it a quirky little East End boozer. The venue's own website says each karaoke room has its own decor and good sound, and the pub has a stage at the front.
worth_knowing: Time Out says Idris Elba has DJed here.
According to the venue's own website, Cage The Elephant, Laura Marling and Metronomy have all played on its stage.
